song_craft: Third-beyond song (21v): leap-the-double (v1) → hangers-on-free (v2) → medicine-remembering (v3) → high-Lord (v4) → begged-glance (v5) → unsweet-drops (v6) → heartless-contempt (v7) → one-vessel (v8) → drowning-flood (v9) → never-leaving-eyes (v10) → thunder-dance (v11) → no-other-yet-knowing (v12) → Śiva-din (v13) → great-Person (v14) → play-lake (v15) → shamed-miseries (v16) → beads-told (v17) → being-unbeing-stuff (v18) → bright-unseen (v19) → knower-in-known (v20) → SEAL keen-and-swoon (v21). Śṛṅgāra throughout.

lines: Things run double — being, unbeing, the two-yoked course.
Leap it. To the Third — bow to wondrous Śambhu.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sadasattvena bhāvānāṃ yuktā yā dvitayī gatiḥ | tām ullaṅghya tṛtīyasmai namaś citrāya śambhave

lines: Gods, seers, men — this triple world unfree.
But free are they who live off Thee alone, O Free — Thy hangers-on.
l4.sanskrit_cite: āsurarṣijanād asminn asvatantre jagattraye | svatantrās te svatantrasya ye tavaivānujīvinaḥ

verses.craft: Triple-unfree vs hangers-on-free; O-Free vocative kept.

lines: Thy body, gem-set with the whole world —
remembering it: the one medicine for existence-pain. Who hold it, sit easy.
l4.sanskrit_cite: aśeṣaviśvakhacitabhavadvapur anusmṛtiḥ | yeṣām bhavarujām ekaṃ bheṣajaṃ te sukhāsinaḥ

lines: Whose white parasol is the moon, lit with its own light;
whose whisk is heaven-river's rush — He alone is high Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sitātapatraṃ yasyenduḥ svaprabhāparipūritaḥ | cāmaraṃ svardhunīsrotaḥ sa ekaḥ parameśvaraḥ

lines: Bright, cool, single, pure — like a moon-sliver —
deal me a glance, Lord, any at all, nectar-flowing.
l4.sanskrit_cite: prakāśāṃ śītalām ekāṃ śuddhāṃ śaśikalām iva | dṛśaṃ vitara me nātha kām apy amṛtavāhinīm

lines: Drops fallen from Thy knowing-bliss sea — these knowings —
why, Lord, in my mouth not nectar-sweet, not lovely?
l4.sanskrit_cite: tvaccidānandajaladheś cyutāḥ saṃvittivipruṣaḥ | imāḥ kathaṃ me bhagavan nāmṛtāsvādasundarāḥ

lines: Hearts undipped in Thy love-sap, Lord —
whose are so, Master, are heartless, nothing else: such are contempt's seat.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tvayi rāgarase nātha na magnaṃ hṛdayaṃ prabho | yeṣām ahṛdayā eva te 'vajñaspadam īdṛśāḥ

lines: Whose heart has met with Thine, Lord —
he, he alone, holds the ruling Ladies' powers: their one high vessel.

lines: Drowner of joys, then sorrows — all, alike —
Thy thought-nectar in flood, over low ground, as water seeks it.

lines: What would their eyes not hold, brimmed with joy-stores —
they who, by more than life, Lord, nowhere ever leave Thee?
l4.sanskrit_cite: keva na syād dṛśā teṣāṃ sukhasambhāranirbharā | yeṣām ātmādhikeneśa na kvāpi virahas tvayā

lines: I thunder — ah! — I dance: my mind-chariots ride full, for my Master is won —
